name: Dr Tom Walsh
bio: Tom has worked in general practice for eight years, mostly with university students and young professionals.

evidence.excerpt: A lot of my patients are uni students with ADHD.
evidence.patientFacing: Tom sees many university students with ADHD.

evidence.excerpt: Burnout and work stress are most of what I see.
evidence.patientFacing: Tom helps with work and study stress, including burnout.

evidence.excerpt: I do mental health care plans regularly.
evidence.patientFacing: Tom provides mental health care plans.

evidence.excerpt: I leave a buffer after first appointments so we're never cut off.
evidence.patientFacing: Tom leaves a 15-minute buffer after first appointments so they don't get cut short.
evidence.scenario: Walk me through a first appointment with a new patient.

evidence.excerpt: I draw the options out on paper so people can see the reasoning.
evidence.patientFacing: Tom sketches out the options during the visit so you can see the reasoning.
evidence.scenario: A patient asks why you're recommending a particular plan.

evidence.excerpt: We go through pros and cons and decide together.
evidence.patientFacing: Tom talks through the pros and cons of each option and decides with you.
evidence.scenario: A patient strongly prefers a treatment you do not initially recommend.

evidence.excerpt: I say what I'd do and what would change my mind.
evidence.patientFacing: Tom tells you plainly what he recommends and what would change his mind.
evidence.scenario: You need to tell a patient a test result isn't what they hoped.

evidence.excerpt: I like to keep my patients with me.
evidence.patientFacing: Tom tries to see his ongoing patients himself rather than handing over.
evidence.scenario: How do you handle patients seeing other GPs in your practice?

evidence.excerpt: If mental health comes up, we deal with it.
evidence.patientFacing: Tom covers mental health when it comes up.
evidence.scenario: A patient comes in about ADHD medication but mentions poor sleep and stress.
